description:
01:58 John 5:21 says the Father raises the dead, but I’ve always believed it was the Son who interacted with humanity throughout the Bible. Didn’t Jesus speak to Moses and Abraham? Where does Scripture clearly say the Father raised anyone?

15:14 Luke 24:1 uses the Greek word sabbaton, which usually means “Sabbath.” Should it be translated “first Sabbath” instead of “first day of the week”? Could this point to the Feast of Firstfruits on the 16th of Nisan? A Messianic Jew in our church claims this means Jesus wasn’t crucified on Friday. Can this be biblically supported?

Who actually raised the dead in Scripture—the Father or the Son?
Does the Bible ever show the Father directly raising the dead?
What do the writings of Ellen G. White say about this verse?

Whether you're a serious Bible student or simply searching for clarity, this study will take you straight to the Word of God for answers.

📖 Let Scripture interpret Scripture—and discover who truly has the power over life and death.

👍 Like, share, and subscribe for more in-depth biblical studies.
